4013.title: Recursive user skill discovery skips links
4013.rootCauseOneLine: The recursive markdown walker skips every symlink before skill parsing, while Grok user roots require recursive scanning.
4013.proposedFix: Define bounded user-skill link following, preserve project restrictions, and retain linked metadata.
4013.caveats: Filesystem discovery reproduced twice; desktop UI and external Grok CLI not run. Automatic fix excluded because it changes the filesystem traversal boundary.
